items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You worked, you said, on the Mary Martin-Ethel Merman special with him, with Bernie. [INTERVIEWEE] With -- yeah. I also worked with -- yeah?

ctx.x: And he would sit down and write these things out, put them all together, and call you up and give them to you. He didn't have time to orchestrate the whole show. So he'd call you and want this, want that, and they're going to do this here and this there. And you'd spend a half hour or so with him. You'd take it home and make the orchestration.
You worked, you said, on the Mary Martin-Ethel Merman special with him, with Bernie.
With -- yeah. I also worked with -- yeah?

items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I think I did the Ethel Merman... and the Ethel Merman show.

ctx.x:
Well, I think I did the Ethel Merman
and what's her name, the girl from Texas, Mary Martin, and
the Ethel Merman show. That was special.

When was that, that was in the
early seventies. Was it in the late sixties. It was in the
sixties. Yes, it was in the sixties.
